# crit_val_sacf {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
crit_val_sacf(M, N; alpha=0.05)
```
Return the asymptotic two sided critical value of the SACF statistic [`stat_sacf`](stat_sacf.qmd) for an `M × N` image. The null hypothesis of no spatial dependence is rejected when the absolute value of the statistic exceeds it.
 
  * `M::Int`: number of rows of the data matrix.
  * `N::Int`: number of columns of the data matrix.
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.

### Examples


```julia-repl
# compute critical value
crit_val_sacf(11, 11)
```


:::
